intro: Research and mentoring activities connect undergraduate student teams, clinical collaborators, and engineering researchers working on rehabilitation robotics and intelligent assistive systems.

members.name: Upper-Limb Rehabilitation Robot Team
members.focus: Reconfigurable mechanisms and rehabilitation robot prototyping

members.name: Spinal Assist Exoskeleton Team
members.focus: Variable-stiffness wearable assistance and experimental validation

members.name: Rehabilitation Hospital Collaborators
members.focus: Patient studies and evaluation of trunk rehabilitation robotics, including collaboration with Beijing Rehabilitation Hospital

members.name: Join the Research
members.focus: Students interested in rehabilitation robotics, robot control, mechanism design, and biomechanics are welcome to get in touch
